assumptions.statement: Official polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage, utilities, fire, flood, traffic, and existing-building surveys are not available in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: All space moves are conceptual reference schemes; geometry and precision-sensitive metrics must be regenerated when cleared official data arrives.

assumptions.statement: The corridor can create more public value when AI testing, civic review, and knowledge sharing use a common auditable interface.
assumptions.impact: Pilot success is judged by reviewability, opt-out, reuse, accessibility, and maintenance—not device count or data volume.
